reason: This plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness plugin-development tool for workspace-scoped capability management: users configure, per project, which Skills and MCP servers are loaded for new sessions, with settings persisted to `.dsh-scope.json` and applied during session initialization.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中按工作区设置新建会话时启用的 Skill 与 MCP 服务器，并将配置写入工作区根目录的 `.dsh-scope.json` 供后续会话读取。
summaries.en: This plugin lets you configure per-workspace enabled Skills and MCP servers in DeepSeek Harness, saving workspace settings to `.dsh-scope.json` for use by later sessions.

capabilities: Per-workspace allowlist/blacklist-style selection of MCP servers
Pre-session loading and filtering of plugin capability context
Popup UI for search, toggles, and bulk enable/disable actions

reasons.code: Readme states plugin enables/disables Skills and MCP servers per workspace and saves settings in workspace root config for subsequent sessions.
Data flow description shows session pre-step reads config and trims model/tool context to enabled sets.
Manifest fields define a DeepSeek Harness web plugin with dynamic client support and runtime integration points.
